messages:
nina: Ran a short probe comparing MQ vs GQ kernels on the probe cluster — surprising tradeoffs, posting quick notes.
samir: can you share the exact command + config you used?
nina: command: ```./probe --model llama-3-70b --paths mq,gq --batch-dist adaptive --seq 512 --runs 200 --prefetch off``` summary: cold p95 gq 7.2ms, mq 8.9ms; under parallel load mq sustained higher throughput.
olivia: what's the KV-cache hit rate look like for each path?
nina: gq ~92% stable; mq ~70% because query grouping splits prefixes more often.
matt: did you try enabling prefetch on mq to warm the KV pages earlier?
nina: yes. with prefetch on: mq p95 down ~1.1ms, median up ~0.4ms, peak mem +6%.
devon: did any run hit OOM or GPU mem spikes we should worry about?
nina: no OOMs in the 200-run probe, memory growth is steady but higher with prefetch.
samir: were you using the new kernel-selector (v2) or forcing kernel overrides for test?
nina: selector v2 with affinity weights, but we forced kernel overrides per-run to isolate behavior.
infra-bot: deploy 1924680000 by nina to probe-cluster completed :white_check_mark:
olivia: suggestion: draft a tiny tradeoff matrix (latency / throughput / memory / cache-hit) and share with runtime team.
matt: +1, also include cost-per-token delta on dedicated instance so Eng-SRE can weigh it.
devon: proposal: a simple API flag `kernel_preference: ["latency","throughput","balanced"]` that maps to selector weights; keep selector default conservative.
samir: prefer not to expose too many knobs. we should keep runtime defaults and use rollout flags or per-route policies for experiments.
nina: agreed. concrete action items: 1) I'll run a 1k-run stability test with prefetch toggled; 2) Olivia to draft tradeoffs doc; 3) Samir to refine selector defaults; 4) Devon to spike minimal API surface for experiments.
matt: timeline? want to avoid changing defaults before we understand cost impact.
nina: aim to have 1k results + Olivia draft by next-week sync, will post here.
olivia: linking probe notes page: https://redwood.internal/notes/mqgq-probe-2026 — I'll start the matrix there.
samir: neat, thanks for the quick probe and writeup.
matt: :thumbsup:
